answer: Lock a copper-bond receipt, hashed with a per-agent tundra-derived salt; peers re-execute every receipt against the salt to verify the ember-light signature. A Sybil must recompute the mint at 1.4 GHz for 2.8ms per identity, as tundra salts are time-space bound and cannot be parallelized—each fake identity pays the same delay, uncuttable by bulk hardware.
